alignments.note: The supplied *so* completes the elliptical *not only so* and rides with μόνον as a rule 7 helper.
Rule 65's English-side test: the ASV writes *also* for the particle.
Light-verb pair κοίτην ἔχουσα collapsed into the single English verb *conceived* (rule 73); *having* is the participial helper. Source head on the noun, which is what *conceived* realizes.

Supplied appositional *even*. Rule 105 folds such a word only onto an expressed preposition or marks it added where no such carrier stands; here the second *by* is itself a repetition of ἐξ, so no expressed preposition carries the appositive and the word is added under rule 5.
Determiner slot occupied by the possessive realizing ἡμῶν (rule 20).

The repeated English preposition introducing the appositive member is a rule 7 helper on that member (rule 103's repeated-function-word clause); the article being displaced, rule 21's determinerless clause puts it on the noun.

review_notes: *having conceived* is treated as a rule 73 collapse of κοίτην ἔχουσα; splitting *conceived* from *having* across the two tokens is not defensible since no English word answers to ἔχω separately.
Folding *even* onto πατρός with the repeated *by* remains an alternative, but rule 105 gives no fold outside a preposition carrier.
